name: Minecraft Schematic to Voxel Conversion
definition: Converts a Minecraft .schematic (NBT) file into a FileToVox Schematic structure by parsing block IDs, metadata, and colors, then iterating through the voxel grid to populate the output.
summary: Minecraft Schematic to Voxel Conversion parses NBT block data into voxels by directly interpreting Minecraft's specific block ID and metadata system rather than reconstructing geometry from meshes.
